title: 食堂の落とし物
summary: 食堂のピークが終わって、注文端末のあたりで学生証の落とし物が出た。かなめに頼まれて、注文端末から返却口まで持ち主の手がかりを追う。
summary_en: The lunch rush is over and a student ID turned up near the order terminals. Kaname asks you to trace the owner from the order terminals to the tray return.
rewardText: かなめが食堂の常連として顔を覚えてくれた
rewardText_en: Kaname now knows you as a cafeteria regular

steps.text: 食堂 1 階の注文端末を調べる
steps.text_en: Check the order terminals on the first floor of the cafeteria

steps.text: 返却口で落とし主の手がかりを探す
steps.text_en: Look for a clue about the owner at the tray return

steps.text: かなめに学生証を渡す
steps.text_en: Hand the student ID to Kaname
